questions.name: Latest seven charges · oldest → newest
questions.description: Latest seven eligible individual charges due before today, ordered by due date and immutable charge ID. Overdue: current remaining >0.005; green: fully paid on time; orange: settled late. Today/future, invalid, zero and default-accounting obligations excluded. Grey means fewer than seven eligible charges. Hover a light for date, loan and amounts. No date-filter mapping.

native.query:
WITH chosen AS (SELECT * FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
), latest AS (SELECT h.*,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY h.due_date DESC,h.charge_id DESC) rn
 FROM chosen c JOIN public.reporting_charge_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id) WHERE h.history_eligible ORDER BY h.due_date DESC,h.charge_id DESC LIMIT 7)
 SELECT s.pos AS "Position",1 AS "Light",1 AS "Size",
 CASE WHEN h.charge_id IS NULL THEN 'No earlier charge' WHEN h.is_overdue THEN 'Overdue' WHEN h.on_time THEN 'Paid on time' ELSE 'Paid late' END AS "Status",
 h.due_date AS "Charge date",c.borrower_name||'-'||to_char(l.original_principal,'FM999,999,999,990.00')||'-'||to_char(l.loan_date,'DD/MM') AS "Loan",h.principal_due AS "Principal due ฿",h.interest_due AS "Interest due ฿",
 h.remaining_current AS "Remaining ฿",h.final_settlement_date AS "Settlement before today"
 FROM chosen c CROSS JOIN generate_series(1,7) s(pos) LEFT JOIN latest h ON h.rn=8-s.pos
 LEFT JOIN public.reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1 l ON l.loan_id=h.loan_id ORDER BY s.pos

questions.name: Total outstanding principal ฿
questions.description: Borrower lifetime/current loan groups; ignores activity dates. Active return = lifetime active-loan interest / current outstanding principal. Closed totals use only loans whose current status is Closed, including defaulted closures. Interest is gross signed receipts. Coverage date is the existing constant-daily-interest estimate; when already covered it displays the current reporting date, not a historical crossing date.

native.query:
WITH chosen AS (SELECT * FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
), totals AS (SELECT b."Total Outstanding Principal" principal,b."Active Loan Interest Earned" interest,b."Projected Interest Coverage Date" coverage,
 z.principal closed_principal,z.interest closed_interest FROM chosen c JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=c.borrower_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(original_principal IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(original_principal) END principal,
 CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(interest_received IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(interest_received) END interest
 FROM public.reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1 l WHERE l.borrower_id=c.borrower_id AND l.loan_status='Closed') z) SELECT principal AS "Total outstanding principal ฿" FROM totals
